verdict.rationale: Vestd documents structured shareholder communications sent from the platform, with segmented mailing lists for targeted updates (vestd-docs-3, vestd-docs-13). Its data rooms can share cap tables with chosen people under access control (vestd-docs-21). An investor-facing portal view of holdings is only implied, by a 'shareholder-dashboards' page whose only text is 'Invite your team' and by recipients acting through their own accounts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an investor/shareholder portal showing individual holdings, evidence that investors (not just employees) get dashboard access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
